江湖事，江湖了
房间里，王一川看着桌上的这一张残图，思量再三，还是命刚才的仆役将其再次放回了隋缘手中的锦囊里。
“此事，不得对任何人说起。”
王一川沉声道。
“是。”
房间内的众人纷纷拱手抱拳，环视周围一眼，王一川这才迈步离去。
看着父亲和众人离去的身影，少年站在桌前，心中不知在思量着什么。
他虽然天赋异禀，但这些朝堂与江湖上的事情最多只能算是道听途说，很难理解这些人做事情的方式方法。
摇头将这些自己搞不懂的事情抛出脑外，吩咐房间内的侍女照顾好隋缘后，少年这才迈步回了自己的房间。
房间内，侍女放下了床前的帘帐，回身掩上了房门。
床上，静静等了片刻，直到确认周边没有动静后，原本昏迷中的隋缘却是陡然睁开了双眼。
环视四周，是自己做梦都没有见过的精致床榻。
“城主府果然不一样！”
心中感慨了一句，隋缘仍旧躺在床上，眼角的余光透过帘帐打量着房间内的一切，直到确认房间内再没有其他人，这才缓缓的动了动自己有些僵硬的身子。
自小在乞丐堆里面长大，装死可是隋缘的拿手好戏。
缓缓的坐起身，隋缘看着手中的锦囊，心中却是有些难以平静。
原本自己只想着趁人不注意捡个漏，却没想到这个天上掉下来的金元宝实在太烫手，以至于自己的小命差点都交代了去。
“眼下唯一能保我安全的地方就是这城主府了！”
隋缘握着手中的锦囊，开始思量之后的打算。

自己无意中卷入了长刀门与其他几大势力的交锋，若没有一座靠山，自己这条小命恐怕顷刻间就会被碾碎。
流落街头的小乞丐，平常最会察言观色，遇到自己无法解决的问题，也最会借力而行，这都是老乞丐手把手教给他的，若没有这份机灵，他一个小孩子也不会活到现在。
“城主大人么？”
想到刚刚听到的几人的对话，隋缘低声自语了一句，心中不由得有些感慨。
自己这种最低贱的小人物，真是做梦也没想到会有一天能够睡在城主府的大床上。
“王令先。”
想到城主王一川的这个小儿子，隋缘眼中却是闪过了一抹笑意。
城主府小少爷天纵之才，少年秀才的美名在整个平川城可谓是人尽皆知。
另一边，相比于城主府内的太平无事，整座平川城却是暗流涌动。
城东的码头上，长刀门的人将整座码头都封锁了起来，更是从码头管事手里面花大价钱租了五条海船，长刀门的大公子赵飞亲自带队，一行人浩浩荡荡的向着大海深处驶去。
码头不远处，隐藏在各处的目光看着赵飞一行越来越远，直到最后变为一个小点消失在海面上，这才闪身消失在原地。
在这些人离开后不久，又有几条小船向着赵飞一行离开的方向驶去。
“大少爷，后面有人跟上来了。”
船上，有人向立身在船首的赵飞禀报道。
“哼，”

Jianghu matter, Jianghu matter
In the room, Wang Yichuan looked at the broken picture on the table. After careful consideration, he ordered the servant just now to put it back into the brocade bag in Sui Yuan's hand.
"This matter must not be mentioned to anyone."
Wang Yichuan said in a deep voice.
"Yes."
Everyone in the room clasped their hands and looked around before Wang Yichuan walked away.
Watching his father and everyone leaving, the young man stood in front of the table, thinking about something in his heart.
Although he is extremely talented, these things in the court and the world can only be regarded as hearsay at best, and it is difficult to understand the way these people do things.
Shaking his head to throw these things that he didn't understand out of his mind, and instructing the maid in the room to take care of Sui Yuan, the young man walked back to his room.
In the room, the maid put down the curtain in front of the bed, turned around and closed the door.
On the bed, he waited quietly for a moment until he confirmed that there was no movement around him. Sui Yuan, who was originally unconscious, suddenly opened his eyes.
Looking around, he saw an exquisite bed that he had never seen before in his dreams.
"The City Lord's Mansion is really different!"
With a sigh in his heart, Sui Yuan was still lying on the bed, looking at everything in the room through the curtains from the corner of his eye. He didn't slowly move his stiff body until he confirmed that there was no one else in the room.
Growing up among beggars, Sui Yuan was good at pretending to be dead.
Slowly sitting up, Sui Yuan looked at the brocade bag in his hand, but his heart was a little hard to calm down.
Originally, I just wanted to pick it up when no one was paying attention, but I didn't expect that the gold ingot that fell from the sky was so hot that I almost lost my life.
"The only place that can keep me safe right now is the City Lord's Mansion!"
Sui Yuan held the brochure in his hand and began to think about his future plans.
He was inadvertently involved in the conflict between the Changdao Sect and several other major forces. Without a backer, his little life would probably be crushed in an instant.
The little beggar who lives on the street is usually the best at observing people's actions. When he encounters a problem that he cannot solve, he is also the best at borrowing strength to solve the problem. This is what the old beggar taught him step by step. Without this cleverness, he would not be alive as a child until now.
"Lord City Lord?"
Thinking of the conversation he just heard, Sui Yuan murmured to himself and couldn't help but feel a little emotional.
A lowly little person like me never dreamed that one day I would be able to sleep on the big bed in the city lord's mansion.
"Wang Lingxian."
Thinking of the youngest son of the city lord Wang Yichuan, Sui Yuan's eyes flashed with a smile.
The young master of the City Lord's Mansion is a talented young man, and his reputation as a young scholar is well known throughout Pingchuan City.
On the other side, compared to the peace and quiet in the city lord's palace, the entire Pingchuan City was undercurrent.
On the pier in the east of the city, the people from Changdaomen blocked the entire pier, and even rented five ships from the dock stewards at a large price. The eldest son of Changdaomen, Zhao Fei, personally led the team, and the group sailed toward the depths of the sea.
Not far from the pier, hidden eyes watched Zhao Fei and his party getting further and further away, until it finally turned into a small dot and disappeared on the sea, and then disappeared in a flash.
Shortly after these people left, several more boats sailed in the direction that Zhao Fei and his party left.
"Young Master, someone is following you."
On the ship, someone reported to Zhao Fei, who was standing at the bow of the ship.
